description_en: Queries the binary log files of an instance that runs MySQL or MariaDB or the write-ahead logging (WAL) files of an instance that runs PostgreSQL
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS MySQL/RDS MariaDB实例的Binlog日志或RDS PostgreSQL实例的Wal日志
name: DescribeBinlogFiles

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，大于查询开始时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 30 to 100.

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。

取值：30~100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Pages start from 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

BinLogFile.description_en: The details of the log file

Checksum.description_en: The checksum. The value of this parameter is calculated by using the CRC64 algorithm

DownloadLink.description_en: The HTTP-based download URL of the log file. If the return value of this parameter is NULL, ApsaraDB RDS does not provide a download URL for the log file
DownloadLink.description_zh: 支持HTTP协议的下载链接URL，NULL表示没有下载链接

FileSize.description_en:
The size of the log file.

Unit: bytes
FileSize.description_zh:
日志文件大小。

单位：Byte

HostInstanceID.description_en:
The ID of the instance to which the log file belongs. This parameter helps determine whether the log file is generated on the primary instance or the secondary instance.

You can log on to the ApsaraDB RDS console and go to the instance details page. In the left-side navigation pane, click Service Availability to view the values of Primary Instance No. and Secondary Instance No
HostInstanceID.description_zh:
日志文件所在实例编号，用户区分该日志文件中日志产生于主实例或备实例。
您可以前往RDS管理控制台，进入实例详情页，然后在左侧导航栏单击服务可用性，查看主库编号和备库编号

IntranetDownloadLink.description_en: The URL that is used to download files over an internal network

LinkExpiredTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the URL.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

LogBeginTime.description_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
LogBeginTime.description_zh: 日志文件记录的开始时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

LogEndTime.description_en:
The end of the time range to query.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
LogEndTime.description_zh: 日志文件记录的结束时间。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

RemoteStatus.description_en:
The status of the log file that is stored in the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.

Valid values:

Uploading
Completed
RemoteStatus.description_zh:
OSS的存储状态。

返回值：
Uploading：上传中
Completed：上传完成

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of log files on the current page

TotalFileSize.description_en: The total size of the log file

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of log files
